title: ‘I Thought My Career Was Done’: Michael Matthews Earns Surprise Silver Medal at Worlds After Major Setbacks
content:
The 36-year-old Australian has recovered from a pulmonary embolism and two broken wrists in the past year and a half. Silver at worlds has him elated.

Read the full article at ‘I Thought My Career Was Done’: Michael Matthews Earns Surprise Silver Medal at Worlds After Major Setbacks on Velo.
author: Will Tracy
